sunnymods.setting.take_over.tooltip: Shows SunnyMods' list for the title screen's Mods button and Options > Mods... Off brings back Sunrise's own list.
sunnymods.setting.sort.tooltip: The list's order when it opens. The button next to the search changes it there too.
sunnymods.sort.author: Author
sunnymods.setting.rows.tooltip: Comfortable rows have large icons and a line of description; compact rows fit more mods.
sunnymods.setting.show_ids.tooltip: Shows each mod's id in its row, under its name.
sunnymods.setting.accent.tooltip: The colour of the selected row, the chips and the headings.
sunnymods.title: Mods
